summary.en:
- When Jingliu uses her Skill or Ultimate, she gains 1 stack of "Syzygy". When she has 2 "Syzygy" stacks, Jingliu enters the "Spectral Transmigration" state, advances herself, gains an extra "Syzygy" stack, and increase the "Syzygy" cap to 4. In this state, Jingliu gains [[stat:cr]] and can only use Enhanced Skill.
- When Jingliu uses Enhanced Skill, she consumes allies' HP and a stack of "Syzygy" to launch a Blast ATK.
- Whenever allies' HP is reduced, she gains Moonlight stacks, which increases [[stat:cd]]. Additionally, when allies' HP are reduced 20 times, gains 1 "Syzygy" stack.
- Jingliu's performance is heavily dependent on Hyacine. Hyacine E0S1 is especially important for Jingliu, as they allow her to maintain a full uptime on her "Spectral Transmigration" state on top of a solid HP buff.
summary.cht:
- 當鏡流用戰技/終結技時，她會獲得一層【朔望】。有2層【朔望】後就進入【轉魄】狀態，行動提前，獲得更多【朔望】層數並提高上限至4層。在【轉魄】期間，鏡流的[[stat:cr]]提高，並且只能用強化戰技。
- 當鏡流用強化戰技，會消耗隊友生命值和一層【朔望】來造成擴散傷害。
- 每當隊友血量降低，她會獲得一層【月色】，並提高[[stat:cd]]。當隊友血量累積減少20次後會獲得一層【朔望】。
- 鏡流的表現一定程度依賴01風堇，畢竟全隊燒血機制可以有效維持【轉魄】狀態，同時還能獲得生命加成和維持血線。

priority.cht: 星魂1 > 疊影1 [[light-cone:flame-of-blood-blaze-my-path]] > 疊影1 [[light-cone:i-shall-be-my-own-sword]]

details.en:
- E1 increases her [[stat:cd]] and allows Jingliu to deal additional damage to the primary target, increasing Jingliu's strength in single-target combats.
- S1 [[light-cone:flame-of-blood-blaze-my-path]] gives better damage increase than her own S1 [[light-cone:i-shall-be-my-own-sword]] and also contributes to generating "Syzygy" stacks.
details.cht:
- 她的星魂1提高[[stat:cd]]，讓她可以對主目標打出更高傷害，對單環境中比較有優勢。
- 疊影1的[[light-cone:flame-of-blood-blaze-my-path]] 對她的提升比自己的專 [[light-cone:i-shall-be-my-own-sword]]還高，同時還能提供【朔望】疊層。
